func_8021804C_5D351C.title: Create a native pickup visual child
func_8021804C_5D351C.summary: Creates and returns a visual child task through the native actor-effect manager.
behavior: Variant 0 allocates a category-8 child under the global actor-effect manager at D_8015CCBC; the child is not owned by the source actor or source coin task.
The helper returns the allocated child-task pointer from func_802171A8_5D2678, or null if the native category cannot allocate another child.

The returned task stores its model object at task +0x18. Its +0x0C callback advances from initialization (func_80211EF8_5CD3C8) to following (func_80211F70_5CD440) and then fading (func_80212020_5CD4F0).
The child already has native cleanup at task +0x10 through func_80218F30_5D4400; preserve this callback.
The fading callback rebuilds a 24-byte material display list at object +0x80, passed with the 0x60000000 segment tag.

If the child model record places object +0x80 outside original 8 MiB RDRAM, the renderer may be unable to read that display list. The risk depends on the actual address; a low-RDRAM mirror refreshed after native callbacks avoids replacing the existing callback chain.

behavior: The callback reads the owner pose and uses it to update the child visual.
The selector-0x22 effect creates four visual children.
The callback rewrites the child task-owned material list at +0xA4 on each update; a separate graphics-visible copy must be refreshed after these native updates.
cautions: The callback depends on a live owner actor and pose.
The child appearance has not been verified in a live scene.
The task-local material list is GPU-readable only if its address resolves within original 8 MiB RDRAM.

func_801F13B0_5AD2C0.title: Initialize a purple transformation child
func_801F13B0_5AD2C0.summary: Initializes the model, transform, resources, and task-owned material for a purple transformation effect child.
behavior: The initializer configures one selector-0x22 child and supplies its owner pose and scale.
It sets file 0x80, texture 0x152, and object mode byte +5 to 10.
The object material pointer is (child task +0xA4) | 0x60000000; the native callback refreshes that task-owned list each tick.
cautions: Graphics data must resolve in original 8 MiB RDRAM. A CPU-valid task outside that range can still produce an RSP-inaccessible material pointer.

func_801E8C44_5A4B54.title: Count effect descendants
func_801E8C44_5A4B54.summary: Scans a manager’s descendants in the native flat task list and counts a selected child kind.
behavior: The global next-task pointer is at task +0x00 and the unsigned 16-bit hierarchy depth is at +0x20. A subtree continues while each next task has depth greater than its manager; stop at a peer or ancestor.
The scan counts descendants whose byte at +0x64 equals the selector. It does not test byte +0x65.
A new child becomes countable when its kind is initialized, before its first scheduled update.
cautions: The global next pointer is not a parent/child pointer; unrelated tasks may follow a subtree.
The standalone C prototype is not established.

func_801DC554_598464.title: Build a native effect material list
func_801DC554_598464.summary: Writes native material commands into a task-owned display list and invokes the native data-cache writeback routine.
behavior: Writes a material call, primitive and environment color commands, and an end command to the material list.
Native effect callbacks can refresh task-owned material data during updates.

After writing, the routine calls osWritebackDCache with the material-list address and byte length. This records the native sequence; it does not establish whether a recompiled runtime requires an equivalent cache operation.
cautions: The destination must remain valid for the full graphics-use lifetime and resolve within original 8 MiB RDRAM for RSP access.

func_801E0944_59C854.title: Advance a player character transition
func_801E0944_59C854.summary: Updates the native player transition while retaining the same task and object.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The existing player object supplied by the scheduler.

behavior: In transition case 4, clears player-work byte +0x69 while keeping action +0xCC at 0xBA.
A later case advances the player to its idle state; the task and object remain the same through the observed transition.
Player-work byte +0x69 is transition state in this path, not a general alive/dead marker.

func_8021A26C_5D573C.title: Build a native pickup material list
func_8021A26C_5D573C.summary: Writes the material display list used by a native pickup visual child.
behavior: Writes a 24-byte display list at the child object +0x80 address and uses the 0x60000000 segment tag when binding the material.
The fading pickup callback rebuilds this list as the child updates.
The destination must be GPU-readable in original 8 MiB RDRAM; a model record valid to the CPU can still place its material list beyond the renderer-visible region.
